measurement: warm page textures; two forward/reverse cycles; vsync-filtered FrameTiming
geometry: Per-result CPU mesh or Metal vertex deformation with depth testing
limitations: Per-result initial_preparation identifies real input or synthetic fixture.
Real EPUB uses one selected chapter and production pagination; selection and persisted progress are not integrated.
RGBA bytes exclude PDF/native/transient/cached GPU allocations; RSS is whole-process memory.
Pipeline budget exceedance is not measured dropped-frame rate or input-to-display latency.
No Apple Books side-by-side comparison; row curl is not a physical paper solver.
Metal uses GPU vertex deformation and hardware depth; shadows differ from Canvas. Raster finish excludes compositor presentation and display scanout.
Backend request starts at Canvas paint entry or immediately before the Metal render channel call. This is not pointer-to-display latency.
Two text cases reported window_unoccluded=false; all cases collected 160 frames. Visibility at collection does not establish visibility throughout the run.
Paired app retains both rendering backends. Per-case process RSS does not measure exclusive renderer memory.

metal.memory_estimate: conservative pool maximum; observed CVPixelBuffer wrapper count is not live buffer count

clock_alignment.method: Round-trip interval intersection before/after capture; only copies whose entire uncertainty interval lies inside one raster interval are matched.

metal.limitations: Texture ready is not display presentation. Copy bounds join request IDs and add two same-clock durations; they overestimate by reply delivery time and end at Flutter texture acquisition, not screen presentation. Unsampled/coalesced updates remain counted. FrameTiming covers Flutter work only.

results.timing_scope: Flutter-only; native GPU and texture bridge are recorded separately in metal
